- Please enlighten your weight -

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
You're that meanie...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
你這個壞蛋……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Aren't you...?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
難道不是嗎……？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Alright, alright, but you don't have to be mean.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
好吧，好吧，但你沒必要這麼刻薄。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I didn't think you were that
mean. Scram, I ain't in the mood
to talk to you.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
沒想到你居然這麼壞。滾開，我現在沒心情跟你說話。

scripts.text: So do you have business in Lutie?
scripts.translation: 那麼，您有在薑餅城的事嗎？

scripts.text: You don't want to go to Lutie for a tour.
scripts.translation: 您不想去薑餅城旅遊。

scripts.text: What made you come over here?
scripts.translation: 是什麼讓您來到這裡？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Yes.
Well, actually...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
是的。
其實……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I wanted to give my girlfriend
some well baked cookies.
Sadly, in my hometown of
Morocc, we don't have fancy
foods like that.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我想給我的女朋友買一些烤得很好的餅乾。
可惜在我的家鄉莫洛奇，沒有這麼精緻的食物。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I've been asking all these
merchants about it, and I was
told that I could only get them
in Lutie...that's my story.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我問遍了這裡的商人，他們告訴我只有在薑餅城才能買到……這就是我的故事。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Now I'm running out of money and
food...I can't stay here much longer...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
現在我的錢和食物都快用完了……我沒法在這裡多待了……

scripts.text: Do you want me to help you?
scripts.translation: 需要我幫你嗎？

scripts.text: Well, good luck with everything.
scripts.translation: 祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Thank god! Thank you so much.
I knew you would help me~!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
謝天謝地！太感謝你了。
我就知道你會幫我的~！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Umm...
Before we talk about that help...
Er, hmmmm...
Well, you know I'm pretty
much starving to death now...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
那個……
在談那個幫助之前……
呃，嗯……
你知道我現在快餓死了……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Could you please get me some Meat?
I know I'm asking you too much,
but I'm pretty much penniless
so I don't really have much
of a choice...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
能請你給我買些肉嗎？
我知道我要求太多了，
但我現在身無分文，
所以也沒得選……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
.........
How could you be so cold
hearted after hearing my story?
...You're pretty mean!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
………
聽了我的故事你居然這麼冷酷無情？
……你真的很壞！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
...Oh really? Hmm...people said I
could only get the well baked
cookie in Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
……真的嗎？嗯……人們說只有在薑餅城才能買到烤得很好的餅乾。

the entrance to Lutie in
Al De Baran...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我聽說，薑餅城的入口
只在艾爾帕蘭……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So I came here after searching
for Al De Baran...almost
killing myself when I passed the desert...*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
所以我找遍了艾爾帕蘭才來到這裡……
穿越沙漠時差點要了我的命……*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I see...I can understand that you
can't help me. It's alright...
It's not like I have the right
to demand anything of you...
But...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我明白了……我理解你幫不了我。沒關係的……
我也沒資格要求你做什麼……
但是……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
*Sob*...so... hungry...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
*抽泣*……好……好餓……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ah...thanks! Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
啊……謝謝！太感謝你了！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I appreciate that you're
helping me out of the
goodness of your heart,
but...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我很感激你出於好心幫助我，
但是……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
What are you...
Cheap?! You can feed
a starving man more
than this...bring me
more Meat!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
你這是什麼……
小氣鬼！喂一個快餓死的人
這點哪夠吃……
多給我帶點肉來！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I appreciate you bringing
all this for me but...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
謝謝你給我帶這麼多，
但是……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Geez, you want I should
choke myself to death?
I can't eat all of this!
Bring me less Meat, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
天哪，你是想讓我撐死嗎？
我吃不下這麼多！
少帶點肉來，行不行？

scripts.text:
^3355FFHe seemed to have been
starving for a long time.
He ate all the meat I gave him
and it was all gone in a flash.^000000
^0000FF...Oh my! He took my cookies without even asking and ate all of those too!!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF他看起來已經餓了很久了。
我給他帶的肉全被他吃光了，
瞬間就沒了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
*Phew*...thanks.
At long last...
I feel stuffed.
...Oh. Right.
My girlfriend.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
*呼*……謝謝。
終於……
我吃飽了。
……啊，對了。
我女朋友。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Er...about the well-baked
cookie I told you about? Um... I
know I'm being rude and selfish
...But I don't think I can find
it on my own.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
呃……就是我跟你說的那個薑餅？嗯……
我知道這樣很沒禮貌也很自私……
但我覺得自己可能找不到它。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So, could you bring me ^0000FF20 Well-baked Cookies^000000?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
所以，能幫我帶^0000FF20個薑餅^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Although I shouldn't be asking for
any more favors, and you'd have
to go through all this trouble...
while I'd be safe over here...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
雖然我不該再麻煩你，
而且你得費這麼大勁……
而我卻在這裡安安穩穩的……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I really want to make my
girlfriend happy. Everything
would be worth it for
that smile on her face...
I just can't pass this chance up!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我真的想讓我女朋友開心。
為了她臉上的笑容，
一切都值得……
我不能錯過這個機會！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Haven't you been in love...?
Surely you understand the
sway that this woman has
over me! Otherwise...I'd be
selling jewels...anything
other than this.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
你沒談過戀愛嗎……？
你肯定能理解這個女人
對我的吸引力吧！不然的話……
我寧願去賣寶石……
也不會做這種事。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm begging you, since you're
stronger and less delicate
than me, please bring me
^0000FF20 Well-baked Cookies^000000!
For me, it's impossible!!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
求求你了，既然你比我強壯，
也沒我那麼嬌氣，
請幫我帶^0000FF20個薑餅^000000！
對我來說這根本做不到！！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ah~!! Thank you so much!!
There really are many good
people like you in this world.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
啊~！！太感謝你了！！
這個世界上果然有很多像你這樣的好人。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I appreciate what you've done for
me...now I can see her smile with
happiness.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我很感激你為我做的一切……
現在我能看到她幸福的笑容了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hmm, there is still one problem
left for me though...How do I
get back home to Morocc??
Well, if it can make my girl
happy...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嗯……不過還有一個問題……
我怎麼才能回到莫洛奇呢？？
嗯……只要能讓她開心……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
...I'll get around to it.
Sooner or later. Man,
that desert's really big,
you know?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
……我會想辦法的。
遲早的事。天哪，
這片沙漠真的很大啊，
你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I see...I can understand that you
can't help me. It's alright...
It's not like I have the right
to demand anything of you...
But...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我明白了……我理解你幫不了我。沒關係的……
我也沒資格要求你做什麼……
但是……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
非常感謝你！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hmm...I wanna pay you back...
And you're an adventurer...
But I don't got any like...
magic armor or those
cards you guys are
always playing with...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嗯……我想報答你……
而且你也是冒險者……
但我沒有那種……
魔法護甲，或者你們
總是玩的那些卡片……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hmmm...
....I got it!
Sooner or later, you
wanna visit some sort
of wise man or...
...something, right?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嗯……
……我想到了！
遲早有一天，
你會去拜訪某位智者，或者……
……什麼的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Visit my pal ^649664Jacob^000000 in
Morocc. Tell him that I
introduced you. He knows
about a wise man...
Though, he isn't one
himself...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
去莫洛奇拜訪我的朋友^649664雅各布^000000。
告訴他是我介紹你來的。
他認識一位智者……
雖然他自己不算……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ah, sorry, I haven't even told
you my name. My name is...
^0000FFPandger Mayer^000000.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
啊，抱歉，我還沒告訴你我的名字。
我的名字是……
^0000FF潘傑·梅耶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So yeah, tell my pal Jacob
that Pandger Mayer introduced you.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
所以，告訴我的朋友雅各布，
是潘傑·梅耶介紹你來的。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So...you tell 'em:
^0000FFPandger Mayer introduced you^000000
Exactly like that~
^0000FFPandger Mayer introduced you^000000
^FF0000Don't forget it~^000000
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
所以……你就告訴他們：
^0000FF潘傑·梅耶介紹你來的^000000
就照原樣說~
^0000FF潘傑·梅耶介紹你來的^000000
^FF0000別忘了哦~^000000

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Sorry I can't pay you back with
more than this, though. Kinda
stinks, huh?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
抱歉，我只能用這些來報答你了。
有點寒酸，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Here, take this as an extra
token of my gratitute.
This doohickey has been
pretty handy in sticky
situations...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
拿著，這個作為額外的謝禮。
這個小玩意在緊要關頭
還挺好用的……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hopefully, it'll be useful.
Umm...it seems you're carrying too much stuff with you.
Doncha want me to help you?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
希望它能派上用場。
嗯……看起來你帶的東西太多了。
要不要我幫你？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hopefully, it'll be useful.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
希望它能派上用場。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Heh...once gain, thanks for
the help. Take care, guy.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘿……再次感謝你的幫助。
保重，蓋伊。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, thanks a bunch for your
help. Anyways...now I remember
I gotta go back through the
desert again...*Sigh*
Yeah, I better get back...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘿，非常感謝你的幫助。
總之……現在我想起來了，
我還得穿過沙漠回去……*嘆氣*
是啊，我得回去了……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
...no matter how hard it is.
But...yeah. It's gonna be pretty
hard. Crossing the desert...
alone. By myself...crud.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
……不管有多難。
但是……是啊。會很艱難。
獨自穿越沙漠……
就我一個人……該死。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, thanks a bunch for your
help....I ain't sure if I
can make it back to Morocc
in one piece...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘿，非常感謝你的幫助……
我不確定我能不能完好無損地回到莫洛奇……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
But I better go back
to my girlfriend. That's
the point of me coming
here in the first place,
anyway.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
但我得回到我女朋友身邊。
這就是我來的目的，
無論如何。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, thanks a bunch for your
help. Man...Morocc is a long
way off, isn't it? Aw nuts...
I guess if I was crazy
enough to come here because
of my girlfriend...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘿，非常感謝你的幫助。
天哪……莫洛奇離這裡好遠啊，
不是嗎？真糟糕……
我想，既然我為了女朋友
都敢來這裡……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm crazy enough to walk all
way back to Morocc...
...
...unless...
You'll gimme a piggy-back ride?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我也敢一路走回莫洛奇……
……
……除非……
你揹我一下？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
...kidding. I'm not that
big of a jerk, I guess.
Try not to look so
surprised!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
……開玩笑的。我想我還沒那麼混蛋。
別用那種驚訝的眼神看我！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Where am I...?
...Who am I?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我在哪裡……？
……我是誰？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
.....

[Tourist]
Mahahahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
瑪哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
*Drools*...I love chocolate!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
*流口水*……我愛巧克力！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Wait...
I have a girlfriend...
and...and...
cookies...?
I feel sooo lost...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
等等……
我有女朋友……
還有……還有……
餅乾……？
我感覺好迷茫……

scripts.text: ^3355FFWe don't talk to crazy people~^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF我們才不跟瘋子說話呢~^000000

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Where am I?
*Sob*...I guess I got lost...
Hey, where is this!?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我在哪裡？
*抽泣*……我想我迷路了……
嘿，這是哪裡！？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text: This is Alberta.
scripts.translation: 這裡是艾爾貝塔。

scripts.text: This is Al De Baran.
scripts.translation: 這裡是艾爾帕蘭。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ah...I see. So this is
Alberta...crud. I'm
supposed to go to ^0000FFLutie^000000...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
啊……原來如此。這裡是艾爾貝塔……該死。我本來應該去^0000FF薑餅城^000000的……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, thanks for letting me know.
Now at least I know where I am.
Geez...they got boats here
that go everywhere, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘿，謝謝你告訴我。
至少我現在知道我在哪了。
天哪……這裡有船可以去任何地方，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Oh right, everywhere...but Lutie.
Man, this stinks.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
哦對，任何地方……除了薑餅城。
天哪，這太糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Oh...oh right!
Yeah, Al De Baran...
Guess I'm not lost
after all.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
哦……哦對！
是啊，艾爾帕蘭……
看來我並沒有迷路。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I was told that I can see a ^FF0000Clock Tower^000000 in Al De Baran.
Can you tell me where I can find the ^FF0000Clock Tower^000000?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我聽說在艾爾帕蘭可以看到一座^FF0000鐘樓^000000。
你能告訴我^FF0000鐘樓^000000在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text: It's in the center of the town.
scripts.translation: 它在城鎮的中心。

scripts.text: Eh, I think I gave you the wrong town name.
scripts.translation: 呃，我想我告訴你錯誤的城鎮名字了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
..............
You know, I'm beginning
to feel like...
you're pullin' my
chain...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
…………
你知道嗎，我開始覺得……
你在耍我……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hah~!...I knew it! Well, it's
pretty hard to admit when
you do something wrong.
Thanks for being honest, pal.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
哈~！……我就知道！好吧，做錯事時承認確實很難。
謝謝你的誠實，夥計。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Wahhhh~~~!!
Dad~~ let me have a Munak~~~!
Waaahhhh!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
哇哈哈~~~！！
爸爸~~給我一隻殭屍~~~！
哇啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I want Munak, Munakkkk~~!!
Other people have a Munak, why can't I~~?
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
我要殭屍，殭屍~~！！
別人都有殭屍，為什麼我沒有~~？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Munak Munak Munak Munak~~~!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
殭屍殭屍殭屍殭屍~~~！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Er...Ummm...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
呃...那個...

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Munak Munak Munak Munak~~~!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
殭屍殭屍殭屍殭屍~~~！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Tommy, daddy is kind of busy right now...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
湯米，爸爸現在有點忙...

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Munak Munak Munak Munak~~~!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
殭屍殭屍殭屍殭屍~~~！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
*Sigh*...alright...alright. If you want it that bad...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
*嘆氣*...好吧...好吧。如果你這麼想要的話...

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Gosh...being a dad is not an easy
thing to do...Hmmm? Do you have any business with me?
 
[Tommy]
^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
天哪...當爸爸真不是一件容易的事...嗯？你有事找我嗎？
 
[湯米]
^FF0000殭屍殭屍殭屍殭屍！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
....Sorry, what did you say? I have no idea what you're talking about.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
....抱歉，你說什麼？我完全沒聽懂你在說什麼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pandger Mayer introduced you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
潘傑·梅爾介紹你來的。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Oh, you mean that guy in love?
Last time I saw him, he was
leaving to find cookies somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
哦，你是說那個戀愛中的人？
上次見到他時，他正要去某個地方找綠餅人...

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
There is only one reason he could have mentioned my name to you...
 
 
[Tommy]
^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
他提到我的名字，肯定只有一個原因...
 
 
[湯米]
^FF0000殭屍殭屍殭屍殭屍！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
......
*Sigh* For now, I have a favor to
ask of you. Could you bring me
^0000FF1 No Recipient^000000?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
......
*嘆氣* 目前，我有件事想拜託你。你能幫我帶一個^0000FF1魔物信件^000000來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
I need this kid to calm down first...
 
 
[Tommy]
^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我得先讓這孩子冷靜下來...
 
 
[湯米]
^FF0000殭屍殭屍殭屍殭屍！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
^FF0000殭屍殭屍殭屍殭屍！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Oh, thank you so much...
Let me calm this kid down
first. Sorry my little boy is being so loud.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
哦，太感謝你了...
讓我先安撫一下這孩子。抱歉，我兒子這麼吵鬧。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Tommy, Tommy?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
湯米，湯米？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
^FF0000Moo^9F0000naah^5F0000ahhh^3F0000ahhh^000000kkk!!..Err?
What's this, Daddy?

[Jacob]
This is called No Recipient~
With this, I can get you a Munak~
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
這個叫做魔物信件~
有了它，我就能給你弄一隻殭屍~

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Are you serious, Daddy?!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
你是認真的嗎，爸爸？！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Yes, I am~
Have you ever heard me lie?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
是的，我是認真的~
你聽過我說謊嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
.......
I know you always lie to Mommy.
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
......
我知道你總是騙媽媽。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
..........
No no no no no...that's not
considered lying, Tommy.
I am just trying to make it sound better to Mommy~
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
..........
不不不不不...那不算說謊，湯米。
我只是想讓事情聽起來更好一點~

scripts.text:
^3355FFHe looks at his father in
doubt. Kids are too smart
to lie to nowadays...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF他懷疑地看著他的父親。
現在的孩子太聰明了，騙不了他們...^000000

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
So, mister, do you think my Daddy can catch a Munak with this?
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
那麼，先生，你覺得我爸爸能用這個抓到殭屍嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
So, lady, do you think my Daddy can catch a Munak with this?
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
那麼，女士，你覺得我爸爸能用這個抓到殭屍嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: ...not sure.
scripts.translation: 不確定

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Heh!! I knew my Daddy
wouldn't tell me a lie!! Thank you!!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
嘿！我就知道我爸爸不會騙我！謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
(...*Phew!* Thank you~)

[Tommy]
So tell me, mister. Did he lie to me, then?
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
那麼告訴我，先生。他是不是騙我了？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
So tell me, lady. Did he lie to me, then?
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
那麼告訴我，女士。他是不是騙我了？

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Wait...wait, Tommy, that's not true...
(^0000FFGosh, why are you doing this to me, help me already!!^000000)
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
等等...等等，湯米，那不是真的...
(^0000FF天哪，你為什麼要這樣對我，快幫幫我啊！！^000000)

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Can we catch a Munak with this or
not, huh? Tell meeeeehhhh~~~!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
到底能不能用這個抓到殭屍啊？告訴我嘛~~~！

scripts.text: Yes, we can.
scripts.translation: 是的，可以。

scripts.text: No, we can't.
scripts.translation: 不，不行。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Heh heh! I knew it!
Thank you~!!!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
嘿嘿！我就知道！
謝謝你~！！！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Now I can have a Munak!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
現在我可以有一隻殭屍了！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
(...*Phew* Thank you~)
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
(...*呼* 謝謝你~)

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I knew it!! Daddy, you're a liar!!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
我就知道！！爸爸，你是個騙子！！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I hate you...I hate you!!!
I wish Baphomet would take you somewhere and eat you!!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
我討厭你...我討厭你！！！
我希望巴風特把你抓走吃掉！！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Shoot...Tommy, Tommy...
Listen to me....
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
該死...湯米，湯米...
聽我說....

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I don't wanna listen to you!!!
I hate yoooooouhhhh!!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
我才不聽你說話！！！
我討厭你！！！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
....You.

[Jacob]
I don't want to see your ugly face
around here any more...
Leave~!
How could you do this to me, huh?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我再也不想看到你這副醜臉了...
滾開~！
你怎麼能這樣對我，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I hate yoooooouhhhh!!
 
 
[Jacob]
Tommy...Tommy please...
Will you let me explain...?
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
我討厭你！！！
 
 
[雅各布]
湯米...湯米，求你了...
讓我解釋一下好嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I knew it!! Daddy, you're a liar!!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
我就知道！！爸爸，你是個騙子！！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I hate you...I hate you!!!
I wish Baphomet will take you somewhere and eat you!!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
我討厭你...我討厭你！！！
我希望巴風特把你抓走吃掉！！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Shoot...Tommy, Tommy...
Listen to me....
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
該死...湯米，湯米...
聽我說....

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I don't wanna listen to you!!!
I hate yoooooouhhhh!!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
我才不聽你說話！！！
我討厭你！！！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
....You.

[Jacob]
I don't want to see
your ugly face any more.
Leave!
How could you do this to me, huh?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我再也不想看到
你這副醜臉了。
滾開！
你怎麼能這樣對我，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I hate yoooooouhhhh!!
[Jacob]
Tommy...Tommy, please...
Will you let me explain...?
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
我討厭你！！！
[雅各布]
湯米...湯米，求你了...
讓我解釋一下好嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
^FF0000殭屍殭屍殭屍殭屍！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
*Sigh*...that's my boy. Please get me a No Recipient as soon as you can!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
*嘆氣*...那是我的兒子。請儘快幫我弄一封魔物信件！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
^FF0000殭屍殭屍殭屍殭屍！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
....*Sigh* Okay.
I will give you a chance
to make up for your mistake.
Please get me a No Recipient as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
....*嘆氣* 好吧。
我會給你一個機會
彌補你的錯誤。
請儘快幫我弄一封魔物信件。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
....I don't want to talk to YOU
anymore. Get outta here~!
It's your fault my little
boy thinks I'm a big liar!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
....我再也不想
和你說話了。快滾~！
都怪你，讓我兒子
覺得我是個超級大騙子！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
*Phew* Now I can leave him alone.
Kids nowadays are so impatient...I am worried about my son.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
*呼* 現在我可以讓他一個人待著了。
現在的孩子真是不耐煩...我很擔心我的兒子。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
However, I can't do anything
about his temper...I think
he's just too young to know
what he's doing.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
不過，我對他的脾氣
無能為力...我覺得
他只是太小了，不懂
自己在做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
I'm having a hard time trying to
be a good parent, and I'm
beginning to appreciate my
own parents' efforts to raise me.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我很難做一個好父母，
我開始感激
我父母當年
養育我的付出。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Respect your parents while they're
still alive. It's too late to be
sorry after you've lost them.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
趁父母還在世時
要尊敬他們。失去他們之後
再後悔就太晚了。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
I was a wild kid as well...my
parents had a hard time raising
me. I'm ashamed of what I've done
when I was young...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我小時候也很調皮...我
父母養育我很辛苦。我為我
年輕時的所作所為
感到羞愧...

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Those days, my parents couldn't
afford to feed me three meals a
day. And there were many
creditors that always came
to our house early
early in the morning.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
那時候，我父母
連一日三餐都供不起。而且有很多
債主總是
一大早
一大早就來我們家。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Have you every heard about
distraint-papers? As soon
as those creditors put that
distraint-paper on any of my
things,it would no longer be
mine.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
你聽說過
扣押單嗎？只要
那些債主把那張
扣押單貼在我
任何物品上，它就不再
屬於我了。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
I hated my parents for not providing me with a sweet home,
and I became rebellious.
But, no matter how bad I was,
Even in those difficult circumstances...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我恨父母沒有給我一個甜蜜的家，
於是變得叛逆。
但無論我有多糟糕，
即使在那樣艱難的處境下...

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
They never gave up on me.
Later, they told me that I was their one and only hope...
even though I was more of a burden than anything else at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
他們從未放棄過我。
後來，他們告訴我，我是他們唯一的希望...
儘管當時我更像是一個負擔。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Daddy, do you realize you've told
that story hundreds of times already? *Piff~*
Stop it already~
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
爸爸，你難道沒意識到
你已經講過這個故事幾百遍了嗎？*噗~*
別講了嘛~

scripts.text:
^3355FFTommy was jumping and running
around like a crazy rabbit and
eventually bumped against me.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF湯米像只瘋兔子一樣
上躥下跳，
最後撞到了我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
...Tommy, respect your dad.
This is the story of your father's life.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
...湯米，要尊重你爸爸。
這是你父親的人生故事。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
A.aa.aand.!!!

[Jacob]
How many times have I told you
to behave in front of other people?!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我告訴過你多少次
在別人面前要守規矩了？！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Say you're sorry to him!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
向他道歉！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Say you're sorry to her!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
向她道歉！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
*Piff~*

[Jacob]
I don't hear it~!!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我沒聽到~！！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
...I'm sorry...*bows head*
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
...對不起...*低頭*

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Ah~ yes! Didn't you say Pandger Mayer introduced me to you?
He wouldn't introduce me to just anyone. Oh, you must be
...an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
啊~對！潘傑·梅爾是你介紹給我的吧？
他可不是隨便介紹人的。哦，你一定是
...一位冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Right.
I have something to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
沒錯。
我有件事要告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
When you go west from Morocc, and
pass through a cave, you will
arrive at a town called Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
當你從莫洛奇往西走，
穿過一個洞穴，
就會到達一個叫克魔島的城鎮。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
When you get there, you will see an old man named ^0000FFElder Creek^000000.
As a Sage, he has gained the respect of many.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
到了那裡，你會見到一位名叫^0000FFElder Creek^000000的老人。
作為賢者，他深受許多人尊敬。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
People say that many adventurers
are visiting this man for some
reason. Why don't you go talk to him and see if he has some wisdom for you?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
人們說，許多冒險者
都因為某些原因
去拜訪這位老人。你不妨去和他談談，
看看他是否有什麼智慧可以傳授給你？

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Respect your parents when they're
still alive. It's too late to be sorry after you've lost them.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
趁父母還在世時要尊敬他們。
失去他們之後再後悔就太晚了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Hmmm...I just know that there's more that this guy can tell me...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(嗯...我覺得這個人還有更多話想告訴我...)

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
When you have a kid,
don't forget to teach them
this one thing:
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
當你有了孩子，
別忘了教給他們
這一件事：

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
'^0000FFBe good to other people.^000000'
'^0000FFTry to be in someone else's shoes before judging that person.^000000'
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
'^0000FF善待他人。^000000'
'^0000FF在評判一個人之前，試著站在他的角度思考。^000000'
你明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(There's more this guy can tell me, I just know it...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(我覺得這個人還有更多話想告訴我...)

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Now, why don't you visit the Sage?
And I thank you for your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
現在，你不妨去拜訪一下賢者吧。
還有，謝謝你的善意。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
He's in Comodo, if you didn't
catch that. An adventurer like you should be able to get there with no problem.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
他在克魔島，如果你沒聽清的話。
像你這樣的冒險者應該能輕鬆到達那裡。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Thank you for the favour you did
for me...although we couldn't
catch a Munak in the end...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
謝謝你幫了我的忙...雖然最後沒能抓到殭屍...

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
It seems he learned something
through the experience.
He no longer demands something
I cannot do for him, or
misbehaves.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
看來他通過這段經歷學到了一些東西。
他不再要求我做不到的事，
也不再胡鬧了。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
That was another favor you did for me, even if you didn't mean to. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
這也是你幫我的另一個忙，儘管你並非有意為之。謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
*Yawns*....
Today is such a boring day~.
I guess I'd better go take a walk
with my son. Do you want to walk with me?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
*打哈欠*....
今天真是無聊的一天~。
我想還是去和兒子散散步吧。你想和我一起去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jacob's son]
I'm happy to hear that, daddy~
scripts.translation:
[雅各布的兒子]
聽到你這麼說，我很高興，爸爸~

scripts.text:
- Wait a moment! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please enlighten your weight -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！ -
- 您目前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重 -
- 然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Good day, adventurer.
What kind of business
do you have with me?
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
日安，冒險者。
你有什麼事找我？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Are you seeking fortune or
mental relief? If not, do
you wish to finish something
you've started?
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
你是來求財，還是尋求心靈慰藉？
如果不是，你是想完成某件未竟之事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Answer me, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
回答我，冒險者！

scripts.text: I seek fortune!
scripts.translation: 我尋求財富！

scripts.text: I seek...wisdom.
scripts.translation: 我尋求...智慧。

scripts.text: I want to finish what I've started.
scripts.translation: 我想完成未竟之事。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You're honest...!
However, I suggest that you try not to be enamored with wealth.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
你很誠實...！
不過，我建議你不要過於迷戀財富。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Do you know the exact meaning
of the old saying...
^0000FFToo much is as bad as too little^000000?
I will give you what you want if
you answer the way I expect you to.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
你知道這句老話的確切含義嗎...
^0000FF過猶不及^000000？
如果你能按我期望的方式回答，我會給你想要的。

scripts.text: It's necessary to have a lot!
scripts.translation: 擁有很多是必要的！

scripts.text: Too dumb to see the future.
scripts.translation: 太愚蠢，看不到未來。

scripts.text: Too much of a good thing can be bad.
scripts.translation: 好事過頭也會變壞。

scripts.text: Cringe to the powerful.
scripts.translation: 向強者卑躬屈膝。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
...
Get out of my sight,
you greedy fool.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
...
滾出我的視線，
你這個貪婪的蠢貨。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Bah! The more ignorant they are, the more arrogantly they act!
Did you think that I would accept just any meaning?
Take care, you ignorant fool.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
哼！越是無知的人，越是傲慢！
你以為我會接受隨便什麼解釋嗎？
小心點，你這個無知的蠢貨。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
That's right. You know it pretty
well. That adage serves as a lesson in greed.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
沒錯。你懂得挺多。
這句諺語正是對貪婪的警示。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
There is a man I've known for a
long time...he was so greedy for
money and fortune, he didn't care what other people thought of him.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我認識一個很久以前的人...
他對金錢和財富極度貪婪，完全不在乎別人怎麼看。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Consequently, people around him
didn't like him at all. In the end, he lost his friends due to his greed.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
結果，周圍的人都很討厭他。最終，他因為貪婪而失去了朋友。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Of course, this rule applies to
you as well. That sort of thing is a universal principle, after all.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
當然，這個道理也適用於你。
畢竟，這是一種普遍的原則。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
.....
Did you think that I would accept just any meaning??
Take care, you ignorant fool.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
.....
你以為我會接受隨便什麼解釋嗎？
小心點，你這個無知的蠢貨。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I see. I have been trying to help
other people who need advice in
order to improve their lives.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我明白了。我一直試圖幫助那些需要建議的人，
以改善他們的生活。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Since you need my advice
as well, I will try to
impart my wisdom in a
way that you will understand.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
既然你也需要我的建議，
我會試著用你能理解的方式
傳授我的智慧。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Now, tell me what is bothering right now.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
現在，告訴我，是什麼困擾著你？

scripts.text: Boy/girlfriend issue.
scripts.translation: 戀愛問題。

scripts.text: Financial problem.
scripts.translation: 經濟問題。

scripts.text: Bored to death.
scripts.translation: 無聊透頂。

scripts.text: Career issue.
scripts.translation: 職業問題。

scripts.text: I want money.
scripts.translation: 我想要錢。

scripts.text: Give me items, old man.
scripts.translation: 給我物品，老頭。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I'm envious of you! Still, young
folk like you are lucky to
have such problems...sadly,
no one but yourself can really
help you in those kinds of
situations...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我羨慕你！不過，像你這樣的年輕人
有這種煩惱也是幸運的...
遺憾的是，除了你自己，
沒有人能真正幫到你...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
However, the advice I can give you
is this: Be honest with your
beloved. One lie leads to
another lie in no time.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
不過，我能給你的建議是：
對你所愛的人誠實。
一個謊言會迅速導致另一個謊言。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If you treat the person you love
as special to you, that person
will eventually come to
understand your feelings...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
如果你把你愛的人視為特別的存在，
那個人最終會理解你的心意...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
And, remember this...
Everyone has a different way of showing that they love someone.
So...don't be discouraged if your feelings aren't returned.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
還有，請記住這一點...
每個人表達愛的方式都不同。
所以...如果你的心意沒有得到回應，也不要氣餒。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But still, I believe being honest
is the best way to gain your
true love.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
不過，我依然相信，
誠實是獲得真愛
最好的方式。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....well, that is all I can tell
you. I hope you will be happy
with that nugget of wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
....好了，我能告訴你的
就這些了。希望你能從
這點智慧中獲得幸福。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
...yes, everybody has their own
financial problems. However, think of it in this way:
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
...是的，每個人都有自己的
經濟問題。不過，你可以這樣想：

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Money is important to make
a living, but it's not what life is all about.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
金錢對於謀生很重要，
但它並不是生活的全部。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Some may have the life goal of
making fortunes, but I don't think it's the happiest way of living.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
有些人的人生目標是
發大財，但我不認為
這是最幸福的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
As you see, there are powerful
people in this world who can control our lives. But oftentimes...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
正如你所見，這個世界上
有能掌控我們命運的強大人物。但很多時候...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
They are too greedy to be in that
position and they don't have
their priorities straight.
Instead of improving the world, they use their power to only help themselves.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
他們身居高位卻過於貪婪，
分不清輕重緩急。
他們不致力於改善世界，
反而只利用權力來謀取私利。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If I were them, I wouldn't want to
rule the world in that way.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
如果我是他們，
我也不想以這種方式統治世界。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Don't you think we need somebody who can change this world??
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
你不覺得我們需要
一個能改變這個世界的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
.....I apologize for being short
tempered. I just wanted to let
you know that money is not everything. But, it is something you need to live.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
.....抱歉我剛才有些急躁。
我只是想讓你知道，金錢並非一切。
但它是生存所必需的。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I'm aware that greedy people
ridicule this belief, saying
that it is a poor man's effort
to protect his pride.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我知道貪婪的人會嘲笑這種信念，
說這只是窮人
為了維護自尊而做的徒勞努力。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But, I still believe I am right.
After all...I am a Sage.
I hope you will be happy with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
但我依然堅信自己是對的。
畢竟...我是一名賢者。
希望你能從我的忠告中獲得幸福。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Yes, we always need to be
entertained. But...it
seems you may not be satisfied with anything.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
是的，我們總是需要
娛樂。但是...
看來你對任何事物都不滿意。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
It's all about the various tastes
and interests people will have.
Things other people enjoy might not
displease you. Also, if your
mind is unwilling to be happy,
you will not enjoy life.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
這全看個人的品味和興趣。
別人喜歡的東西，
你不一定喜歡。而且，如果你的心
不願快樂，你就無法享受人生。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Here's an example of having
the right frame of mind.
Let's say we're cleaning
the street for the town,
which can be hard, grueling work...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
這裡有一個擁有正確心態的例子。
假設我們在為城鎮清掃街道，
這可能是一項艱苦繁重的工作...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You're always covered in dust.
In the summer, your body is
sticky with sweat...
In the winter, you'll be
be out in the freezing cold...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
你總是滿身灰塵。
夏天，身體被汗水浸溼...
冬天，你又要忍受刺骨的寒冷...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
However, even so, it will be different to someone with a different perspective.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
然而，即便如此，
對於擁有不同視角的人來說，
感受也會截然不同。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Ideally, we should try
to find joy in making
other people happy.
By cleaning the street, we can
give others a reason to smile.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
理想情況下，我們應該
試著從讓別人快樂中找到樂趣。
通過清掃街道，我們可以
給別人一個微笑的理由。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Tourists passing through the street
can enjoy its cleanliness...
Overall, it makes the entire community look good.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
路過街道的遊客
可以享受街道的整潔...
總的來說，這讓整個社群看起來更美好。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If your parents see you cleaning
the street, they will be proud of
their child.
...But now, I think I'm beginning to make no sense.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
如果你的父母看到你
在清掃街道，
他們會為有這樣的孩子感到驕傲。
...不過，我覺得我好像開始說胡話了。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Oh well, I apologize.
Just try to think positively.
With the right attitude, eventually you will find something to enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
算了，抱歉。
試著往積極的一面想吧。
只要心態正確，
你終會找到值得享受的事物。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Haha~ I can see you're just
clicking the 'next' button on these
windows, because you're sick and tired of this NPC conversation.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
哈哈~ 我看出來了，
你只是在瘋狂點選“下一項”按鈕，
因為你已經受夠了這個NPC的對話。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....anyway, that is all.
I hope you will be happy
with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
...總之，就到這裡吧。
希望我的忠告能讓你感到快樂。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
That's an agonizing thought for every young person.
But you have a lot time to think about what you want to do in the future.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
這對每個年輕人來說都是個痛苦的思考。
但你還有大把的時間，
去思考未來想做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Experience more in many different
places, and read as many books
as you can. Focus on broadening your perspective.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
去不同的地方多體驗，
多讀書。專注於拓寬你的視野。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Then, you will realize what you really want to do.
....that's all I can say.
I hope you will be happy with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
那樣，你就會明白自己真正想做什麼。
...我能說的就這些了。
希望我的忠告能讓你感到快樂。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....
I see, you chose the wrong answer in the first place.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
...
看來，你一開始就選錯了答案。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I believe this will be a lesson to be more honest with yourself.
Choose the right answer next time!
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我相信這會是一堂
讓你學會對自己誠實的課。
下次選對答案！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You rascal!
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
你這小無賴！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Get out of my sight immediately! I don't talk to trash!
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
立刻從我眼前消失！
我不跟垃圾說話！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Yes, you need to see things to the end.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
是的，你需要把事情堅持到底。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....*Sigh* Okay.
I forgive you.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
... *嘆氣* 好吧。
我原諒你了。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I do not wish to continue this conversation with you.
Get out of my sight immediately!
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我不想再和你繼續這個對話了。
立刻從我眼前消失！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
...I was just testing you
in order to give you something
special. I'm the only person in the world that can give you this...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
...我剛才只是在考驗你，
為了給你一樣特別的東西。
我是世界上唯一能給你這個的人...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I had to check if you are the right person as I initially thought.
....Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我必須確認你是否像我最初認為的那樣，
是合適的人。
...嗯。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But you don't expect me to give something special without any compensation, do you?
Would you bring the items I want?
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
但你不會指望我
不索取任何報酬就給你特別的東西吧？
你願意幫我帶點東西來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
It's not a hard thing to do.
That is...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
這並不難。
也就是說...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
10 Brigan,
15 Clam Shell,
10 Crab Shell
and 50 Cyfar.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
10個布里刊，
15個蛤蜊外殼，
10個螃蟹外殼
和50個賽依伐。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Well, I am collecting those as my hobby.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
嗯，我收集這些是我的愛好。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I have no doubt that you will be able to gather them all.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我相信你一定能把它們全部收集齊。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Do me this favor, young man.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
請幫個忙，年輕人。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....hmm. I see you want more.
Come back later.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
……嗯，看來你還想要更多。
請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Is there any business left between
us? Tell me, young adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我們之間還有什麼事嗎？
告訴我，年輕的冒險者……

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou feel there may be something you missed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你感覺似乎有什麼東西被遺漏了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I see you know how the world
works. When you need something
from someone, you must give
in order to receive.
Thank you for your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
看來你很懂世故。
想要從別人那裡得到什麼，
就必須先給予。
謝謝你的善意。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Please, take this first.
If you would, please go talk to my
grandson later. He seemed to witness something horrible a while ago...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
請先收下這個。
如果可以的話，
請稍後去和我的孫子談談。
他剛才似乎目睹了可怕的事情……

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I have no idea what he saw,
because the shock took away
his ability to speak.
When he recovers, I will tell you.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我不知道他看到了什麼，
因為巨大的衝擊讓他失去了說話的能力。
等他恢復後，我會告訴你的。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
In fact, the items I have asked
for will be used to cure
his condition. I don't
really collect these as a
hobby...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
其實，我讓你收集的那些物品，
是用來治療他的病情的。
我並不是真的把它們當作愛好來收集……

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I am sorry to cause you
much trouble for my own good.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
為了我自己的事給你添了這麼多麻煩，
我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Remember, when you want something,
especially when it's special, you
should always offer something in exchange.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
記住，當你想要某樣東西時，
尤其是特別的東西，
你應該總是提供某種交換。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I want...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我想要……

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
10 Brigan,
15 Clam Shell,
10 Crab Shell and
50 Cyfar.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
10個布里刊，
15個蛤蜊外殼，
10個螃蟹外殼
和50個賽依伐。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Feel free to come back anytime...
And if you need advice, I am more than willing to help you.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
隨時歡迎回來……
如果你需要建議，我非常樂意幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Do you wish for me to give you advice, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
你想讓我給你一些建議嗎，冒險者？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Now, tell me what bothers you at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
現在，告訴我你目前有什麼煩惱。

scripts.text: Boy/girlfriend issue.
scripts.translation: 戀愛問題。

scripts.text: Financial problem.
scripts.translation: 經濟問題。

scripts.text: Bored to death.
scripts.translation: 無聊透頂。

scripts.text: Career issue.
scripts.translation: 職業問題。

scripts.text: Give me items, old man.
scripts.translation: 給我物品，老頭。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I'm envious of you! Still, young
folk like you are lucky to
have such problems...sadly,
no one but yourself can really
help you in those kinds of
situations...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我羨慕你！不過，像你這樣的年輕人
有這種煩惱也是幸運的...
遺憾的是，除了你自己，
沒有人能真正幫到你...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
However, the advice I can give you
is this: Be honest with your
beloved. One lie leads to
another lie in no time.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
不過，我能給你的建議是：
對你所愛的人誠實。
一個謊言會迅速導致另一個謊言。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If you treat the person you love
as special to you, that person
will eventually come to
understand your feelings...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
如果你把你愛的人視為特別的存在，
那個人最終會理解你的心意...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
And, remember this...
Everyone has a different way of showing that they love someone.
So...don't be discouraged if your feelings aren't returned.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
還有，請記住這一點...
每個人表達愛的方式都不同。
所以...如果你的心意沒有得到回應，也不要氣餒。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But still, I believe being honest
is the best way to gain your
true love.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
不過，我依然相信，
誠實是獲得真愛
最好的方式。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....well, that is all I can tell
you. I hope you will be happy
with that nugget of wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
....好了，我能告訴你的
就這些了。希望你能從
這點智慧中獲得幸福。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
...yes, everybody has their own
financial problems. However, think of it in this way:
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
...是的，每個人都有自己的
經濟問題。不過，你可以這樣想：

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Money is important to make
a living, but it's not what life is all about.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
金錢對於謀生很重要，
但它並不是生活的全部。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Some may have the life goal of
making fortunes, but I don't think it's the happiest way of living.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
有些人的人生目標是
發大財，但我不認為
這是最幸福的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
As you see, there are powerful
people in this world who can control our lives. But oftentimes...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
正如你所見，這個世界上
有能掌控我們命運的強大人物。但很多時候...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
They are too greedy to be in that
position and they don't have
their priorities straight.
Instead of improving the world, they use their power to only help themselves.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
他們身居高位卻過於貪婪，
分不清輕重緩急。
他們不致力於改善世界，
反而只利用權力來謀取私利。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If I were them, I wouldn't want to
rule the world in that way.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
如果我是他們，
我也不想以這種方式統治世界。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Don't you think we need somebody who can change this world??
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
你不覺得我們需要
一個能改變這個世界的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
.....I apologize for being short
tempered. I just wanted to let
you know that money is not everything. But, it is something you need to live.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
.....抱歉我剛才有些急躁。
我只是想讓你知道，金錢並非一切。
但它是生存所必需的。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I'm aware that greedy people
ridicule this belief, saying
that it is a poor man's effort
to protect his pride.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我知道貪婪的人會嘲笑這種信念，
說這只是窮人
為了維護自尊而做的徒勞努力。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But, I still believe I am right.
After all...I am a Sage.
I hope you will be happy with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
但我依然堅信自己是對的。
畢竟...我是一名賢者。
希望你能從我的忠告中獲得幸福。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Yes, we always need to be
entertained. But...it seems
you may not be satisfied
with anything.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
是的，我們總是需要娛樂。
但是……
似乎沒有任何東西能讓你感到滿意。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
It's all about the various tastes
and interests people will have.
Things other people enjoy might
displease you. Also, if your
mind is unwilling to be happy,
you will not enjoy life.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
這全在於每個人不同的品味和興趣。
別人喜歡的東西可能會讓你反感。
而且，如果你的心不願意快樂，
你就無法享受人生。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Here's an example of having
the right frame of mind.
Let's say we're cleaning
the street for the town,
which can be hard, grueling work...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
這裡有一個擁有正確心態的例子。
假設我們在為城鎮清掃街道，
這可能是一項艱苦繁重的工作...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You're always covered in dust.
In the summer, your body is
sticky with sweat...
In the winter, you'll be
be out in the freezing cold...
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
你總是滿身灰塵。
夏天，身體被汗水浸溼...
冬天，你又要忍受刺骨的寒冷...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
However, even so, it will be different to someone with a different perspective.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
然而，即便如此，
對於擁有不同視角的人來說，
感受也會截然不同。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Ideally, we should try
to find joy in making
other people happy.
By cleaning the street, we can
give others a reason to smile.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
理想情況下，我們應該
試著從讓別人快樂中找到樂趣。
通過清掃街道，我們可以
給別人一個微笑的理由。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Tourists passing through the
street can enjoy its
cleanliness...
Overall, it makes the entire community look good.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
路過這條街的遊客可以欣賞它的整潔……
總的來說，這讓整個社群看起來更好。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If your parents see you cleaning
the street, they will be proud of
their child.
...But now, I think I'm beginning to make no sense.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
如果你的父母看到你
在清掃街道，
他們會為有這樣的孩子感到驕傲。
...不過，我覺得我好像開始說胡話了。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Oh well, I apologize.
Just try to think positively.
With the right attitude, eventually you will find something to enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
算了，抱歉。
試著往積極的一面想吧。
只要心態正確，
你終會找到值得享受的事物。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Haha~ I can see you're just
clicking the 'next' button on
these windows, because you're sick and tired of this NPC conversation.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
哈哈~ 我看你只是在點選這些視窗的“下一個”按鈕，
因為你已經受夠了這種NPC對話。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....anyway, that is all.
I hope you will be happy
with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
...總之，就到這裡吧。
希望我的忠告能讓你感到快樂。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
That's an agonizing thought for every young person.
But you have a lot time to think about what you want to do in the future.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
這對每個年輕人來說都是個痛苦的思考。
但你還有大把的時間，
去思考未來想做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Experience more in many different
places, and read as many books
as you can. Focus on broadening your perspective.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
去不同的地方多體驗，
多讀書。專注於拓寬你的視野。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Then, you will realize what you really want to do.
....that's all I can say.
I hope you will be happy with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
那樣，你就會明白自己真正想做什麼。
...我能說的就這些了。
希望我的忠告能讓你感到快樂。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You rascal!
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
你這小無賴！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Get out of my sight immediately! I don't talk to trash!
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
立刻從我眼前消失！
我不跟垃圾說話！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I hope you will enjoy your life. Remember, time flies and you live only once.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
願你享受你的生活。
記住，時光飛逝，人生只有一次。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I have been helping people by giving them advice to improve their lives.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
我一直通過提供建議來幫助人們改善生活。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Since you need my help as well, I shall endeavor to impart some wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
既然你需要我的幫助，我會盡力傳授一些智慧。

scripts.text:

Now tell me, what bothers you right now?

That's an agonizing thought for every young person.
But you have a lot time to think about what you want to do in the future.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
這對每個年輕人來說都是個痛苦的思考。
但你還有大把的時間，
去思考未來想做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Experience more in many different
places, and read as many books
as you can. Focus on broadening your perspective.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
去不同的地方多體驗，
多讀書。專注於拓寬你的視野。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Then, you will realize what you really want to do.
....that's all I can say.
I hope you will be happy with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
那樣，你就會明白自己真正想做什麼。
...我能說的就這些了。
希望我的忠告能讓你感到快樂。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You rascal!
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
你這小無賴！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Get out of my sight immediately! I don't talk to trash!
scripts.translation:
[長老 克里克]
立刻從我眼前消失！
我不跟垃圾說話！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Wahhhhhh~~~!!
Daddy~~ let me have a Munak~~~!
Waaaahhhh....
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
哇啊啊啊~~~！！
爸爸~~給我一隻殭屍~~~！
哇啊啊啊....

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I want my Munak~~!!
Other people have one, why can't I have one too?!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
我要殭屍~~！！
別人都有，為什麼我沒有？！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Munak Munak Munak Munak~~~
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
殭屍殭屍殭屍殭屍~~~

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Umm..Tommy...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
嗯...湯米...

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Munak Munak Munak Munak~~~
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
殭屍殭屍殭屍殭屍~~~

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Tommy, your daddy is kind of busy now...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
湯米，你爸爸現在有點忙...

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Munak Munak Munak Munak!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
殭屍殭屍殭屍殭屍！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Sigh...alright, alright...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
唉...好吧，好吧...

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
*cries*...I want Munak!....*cries*
My friends all have Munak, and I don't have it...
Waaaahhhhh~~
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
*哭泣*...我要殭屍！....*哭泣*
我的朋友都有殭屍，我沒有...
哇啊啊啊~~

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Daddy, I hate you!!
I hate all of you!!!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
爸爸，我討厭你！！
我討厭你們所有人！！！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Waaaahhh~~~!
I don't care what anybody's telling
me! I'll be bad because I hate everyone!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
哇啊啊啊~~~！
我才不管別人怎麼說！
我討厭所有人，所以我要變壞！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Heh~!
I'm so happy~
We're gonna get a Munak~!
Heh heh heh~!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
嘿嘿~！
我好開心~
我們要去抓殭屍了~！
嘿嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Heh~!
I am so happy~
We're gonna get a Munak~!
Heh heh heh~!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
嘿嘿~！
我好開心~
我們要去抓殭屍了~！
嘿嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Heh~!
I like you~ 
Cuz now we're gonna
get a Munak~
So happy! *smiles*
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
嘿嘿~！
我喜歡你~
因為現在我們要
去抓殭屍了~
好開心！*微笑*

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Daddy...I won't ask you for something that's too hard for you.
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
爸爸...我不會向你索要太難的東西了。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I saw you're huffing and puffing when we went to catch a Munak.
I'm so sorry that I gave you a hard time, daddy...
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
我看你抓殭屍的時候很吃力。
爸爸，對不起，讓你為難了...

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I will be good from now on.
I will be nice to my Daddy, to you and to anyone.
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
從今以後我會乖的。
我會對爸爸好，對你好，對每個人都好。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
My dad told me that I will be a good kid if I don't behave bad sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
爸爸告訴我，只要我不調皮搗蛋，就會是個乖孩子。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I hate to see my daddy resting in his room all day in the weekends.
But I am so happy today because my daddy and I will take a walk together!!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
我不喜歡看到爸爸週末整天都待在房間裡休息。
不過今天我很開心，因為爸爸要和我一起去散步！！
